title: Maximize Value of Function in a Ball Passing Game
summary: Players 0..n-1 with receiver array; from start x, ball passes k times along receiver; f(x) is sum of all touched player indices including repeats and start. Return max f(x).
visualizationNotes: Visualization cap: n <= 24 (GraphTraversalView node limit); k is simulated with binary lifting in the trace.
